characters.name: Adam Rooke
characters.story_function: a man taught that attachment is a policy, handed a power that rewards treating the living as material

core.wound: abandoned at nine, robbed at thirty-three, killed at thirty-eight for an insurance policy
core.lie: every attachment is a policy someone has taken out on you
core.want: to make existence pay what it owes him
core.need: to be wanted by someone who gains nothing by it
core.fear: that he was always disposable and the betrayals were simply correct
core.moral_axis: the few known vs the many unknown

surface.mask: genuine courtesy that costs him nothing

bonds.loyalty_shape: loyal to no one, scrupulously fair to everyone
bonds.leverage_over_them: unearned kindness frightens him, and frightened is when he is most dangerous
bonds.leverage_they_hold: nobody knows what he is until far too late

characters.offstage_life: reciting nine names in an order that has never changed

trajectory.arc_shape: tragic fall followed by a survival he did not plan for
trajectory.break_point: Movement III, when he finishes and the feeling does not arrive
trajectory.exit_condition: he lives, he leaves, he takes the count with him

contract.entry_pretext: the novel opens on his death
first_appearance_conditions: the courtesy lands before the wound

contradictions: he is never crueller than when he is being kind

surface.verbal_tic: goes silent for exactly as long as it takes to unnerve
surface.physical_signature: carries a smell that belongs to a place they left

capability.spike: can be forgotten at will; people lose them in memory
capability.secondary: can hold a body together with improvised materials
capability.hole: flinches at kindness faster than at threat

bonds.loyalty_shape: loyal to the institution over every individual in it
bonds.to_protagonist: undefined — set on first shared scene
bonds.leverage_over_them: knowledge that they running a second, incompatible life in another district

trajectory.break_point: undefined — name the scene that cracks them
trajectory.exit_condition: undefined — how they leave the novel, on or off the page

contract.entry_pretext: attached to an institution the POV just entered
first_appearance_conditions: The scene must need them for a reason the reader already feels.
They arrive mid-action, doing their own business, not waiting to be met.
One concrete detail from `surface` lands in the first three lines.
contract.do_not_reveal_before: the wound; it is earned, never introduced

contradictions: The mask (principle invoked at exactly the moment it is convenient) cannot protect the spike (can be forgotten at will; people lose them in memory) when it is tested in public.
Their loyalty (loyal to the institution over every individual in it) guarantees they will meet the thing they fear: being fully known.
The lie — Anyone who truly sees me will leave, so show them a version that stays. — will look true for most of their time on the page.
